2609.27370.title: Geometry-Conditioned Visual Place Recognition in Natural Environments
2609.27370.paper_summary: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) in natural environments remains challenging due to repetitive vegetation, sparse distinctive landmarks, and substantial appearance and viewpoint variation across traversals. While visual observations of the same place can change considerably, their underlying spatial structure is often more persistent. We exploit this complementary geometric consistency through Depth-Aware Distillation (DAD), which conditions the token representations of a pretrained Vision Foundation Model (VFM) on geometry inferred by a Geometric Foundation Model (GFM), without any depth sensor. Rather than treating geometry as an additional input modality, DAD projects image-aligned depth into the VFM token space and selectively modulates visual representations through channel-wise geometric conditioning. A two-stage teacher-guided learning strategy first anchors the geometry-conditioned representation to the pretrained appearance space, before refining it for place discrimination. Evaluated on the WildCross benchmark, DAD improves average inter-sequence Recall@1 from 61.41% to 66.37% and Recall@5 from 65.86% to 72.49% over a matched appearance-only baseline, with the largest gains under reverse traversal and long-term appearance variation. These results show that GFM-derived geometry can provide a persistent structural prior for VPR when visual appearance becomes unreliable.
2609.27370.paper_summary_zh: 視覺位置識別（VPR）在自然環境中仍然具有挑戰性，因為重複的植被、稀疏的獨特地標以及穿越過程中外觀和視角的顯著變化。雖然對同一地點的視覺觀察可能會有很大變化，但其潛在的空間結構往往更為持久。我們通過深度感知蒸餾（DAD）利用這種互補的幾何一致性，該方法在不使用任何深度傳感器的情況下，將預訓練的視覺基礎模型（VFM）的標記表示與由幾何基礎模型（GFM）推斷的幾何結構進行條件化。DAD並不將幾何視為額外的輸入模態，而是將圖像對齊的深度投影到VFM標記空間中，並通過通道級幾何條件選擇性地調節視覺表示。一種兩階段的教師引導學習策略首先將幾何條件表示固定到預訓練的外觀空間，然後再進行精煉以進行位置區分。在WildCross基準上進行評估，DAD將平均序列間Recall@1從61.41%提高到66.37%，將Recall@5從65.86%提高到72.49%，相較於匹配的僅外觀基線，在逆向穿越和長期外觀變化下獲得了最大的增益。這些結果表明，GFM衍生的幾何可以為VPR提供持久的結構先驗，當視覺外觀變得不可靠時。
